publicApiSource: data/sdk/webwindows-public-api-v1.d.ts (draft additions: ai.isSupported / ai.requestAssist / ai.on; d.ts edit deferred per repo rule 4)
notes: Phase 0B proposal: the ai public namespace is not yet registered in production; facade will not generate the ai namespace for packages that do not declare ai.desktalk-assist.
Host-owned confirmation card precedes every requestAssist: a sandbox button click is never proof of authorization (Broker protocol section 8).
Rate/size limits follow the design doc: payload <= 16 KiB, one in-flight request per app, 6 requests/minute, 120s ticket lifetime.
Audit logs record requestId/scene/decision/category/latency/payload-bytes only - never payload content.

payload.describedBy: docs/WEBWINDOWS_MEDIA_EDITING_APP_SUPPORT_V1.md video-edit scene summary schema (assetReport + timeline digest; no binary, no user-selected file contents)

methods.sanitization: Payload validated as JSON text <= 16 KiB against the video-edit scene schema before handoff; ticket result carries an opaque id and no generated content - the actual suggestions flow back via the ai.assist.received event bound to the same ticket. null on host decline (fail-closed, mistake-silent).

notes: Phase 0B keeps exactly one event shape per the design doc; expansion requires a new review.
Proposals are itemized confirmation cards - DeskShadow never auto-applies; each applies only after the user accepts it in the app UI.
The sandbox must render the attribution '桌讯 AI 协助' for anything received via this channel.

reviewedNotSelected.reason: Letting a sandbox enumerate which DeskTalk session to route into leaks social context; routing is host-side.
Ticket expiry (120s) plus one-in-flight policy covers cancellation adequately for Phase 0B.
